rpa-abb: RPA-ABB is an urban hit squad and guerrilla group of the Communist Party in the Philippines.
RPA-ABB means the same as Alex Boncayao Brigade or ABB or Revolutionary Proletarian Army.
rpm: Rpm is rate of revolution of a motor.
For example: "The engine was doing 6000 revs."
Rpm means the same as revolutions per minute or rev.
